blurb: Checks DISA AIX STIG V-215410 (medium): AIX must boot only from the system boot device. A non-hard-disk device (cd, rmt, ent, network, usb, tok, fddi, or other) in the normal boot list is a finding, and a boot list with no boot device configured is a finding. The SMS firmware multi-boot clause is not visible from the OS, so a hard-disk-only normal boot list still renders NOT_ASSESSED for the manual portion; this check never emits PASS for V-215410.
